event.name: Queer Tables: Queer Italian Pasta
event.descriptionText:
Come when you can, leave when you must. All are welcome at our table – undergrads, grad students, faculty and staff! 

This is a relaxed and fun place for finding queer joy, chatting across languages, and sharing a small, yummy meal. 

The pasta dish is cooked in the LGBTQ Center's kitchen and varies session by session. Vegan and gluten-free options are always available, and we do our best to accommodate any other dietary requirements.

Queer Italian Pasta is hosted by the Italian Studies Department and LGBTQ Center. Registration is not necessary.
